translation: Our Lord Gaura came chanting “Hari! Hari!”
Lord Gaurāṅga-chānda came looking very disheveled, as if mad, due to ecstatic love of God, and along with Lord Nityānanda and Advaita Āchārya He entered the land of Godruma.

text: nāmera hāṭe ese preme jagata bhāsāila
translation: Deeply absorbed in the intoxicating mellows of saṅkīrtan, He distributed the Holy Name. Having come to the marketplace of the Holy Name, He caused the whole universe to swim in ecstatic love of God.

Today all the miseries of the residents of Godrumadvīp have gone far away, for Lord Gaurāṅga, having come here along with all His devotees, caused the marketplace of the Holy Name to appear here in Godruma.

text: nādīya bhramite gorā ela nāmera hāṭe
gaura ela hāṭe, saṅge nitāi ela hāṭe
translation: Wandering all over the land of Nadia, Lord Gaura came to the marketplace of the Holy Name. Lord Gaura came to the marketplace along with Nitāi.
Maddened with ecstasy Lord Nityānanda dances in the fields of Godruma. Due to ecstatic love of God, He moves His powerful arms like a challenging wrestler and thus overwhelms the universe in ecstasy.

(O, all of you please go and see!) The Vaiṣṇavas headed by Advaita Āchārya are dancing along the banks of the Gaṅgā from one bathing ghat to the next! At such a sight as this, the wicked personality Kali falls into great danger and thus runs for his life.

text: ki sukhe bhāsila jīva gorāchāndera nāṭe
translation: In what indescribable happiness did all living beings swim while Lord Gaurachandra was dancing? By seeing and hearing of such Pastimes, the hearts of the atheists break.
